timeline.summary: Ndr Auto received IT appellate orders for three assessment years reducing demand from ₹3.07 Cr to ₹0.24 Cr.
NDR Auto Components filed its annual promoter shareholding and encumbrance disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of SEBI SAST Regulations for FY26.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹229.07 Cr (+19.3% YoY), net profit ₹18.45 Cr (+12.6% YoY).
NDR Auto reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹822.54 Cr and an order book of ₹650 Cr.

NDR Auto Components Limited uploaded audio recording of its May 12, 2026, Analyst/Investor Conference Call featuring Mr. Pranav Relan, Mr. Rajat Bhandari, Mr. Vikram Krishan Rathi, and Mr. Rakesh Rustagi on ndrauto.com.
Ndr Auto reported Q4 FY26 total income of ₹229.89 crore (+19% YoY) and an order book of ₹650 crore.
NDR Auto Components Limited preponed its Analyst/Investor Meeting to May 26, 2026, at 9 a.m. for Dalton Investments and Marval Capital Ltd at Gurgaon.

NDR Auto Components Limited held its Q1FY27 earnings conference call on August 11, 2026, reporting revenue of ₹221.45 Cr, EBITDA of ₹26.44 Cr, and PAT of ₹16.40 Cr. The company announced the commencement of operations at NDR Hayashi facility in Bangalore and the inauguration of NDR South plant in Anantapur, with SOP starting in Q2FY27. Bharat Seats revenue grew by 35% YoY, and management raised its target to ₹3,500 Cr by FY30.
Ndr Auto Components announced the reaffirmation of its credit rating of [ICRA]A+ (Stable) / [ICRA]A1+ on ₹100 crore of bank facilities by ICRA Limited.
